ignition-orange.$description: Ignition Orange — Primary CTAs and eyebrow labels — the sole warm accent, providing a clear, unmissable call to action.

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Secondary surfaces, like contained button backgrounds.

graphite.$description: Graphite — Tertiary surfaces, small button backgrounds.

stark-white.$description: Stark White — Headline text, icon fills.

dusk-gray.$description: Dusk Gray — Secondary text, navigation links.

tomorrow.$description: All headings, subheadings, and prominent UI labels. Its technical, semi-monospace structure and distinctive letter-spacing define the brand's futuristic, tool-like identity.

inter.$description: All body copy and long-form text. Its neutrality provides a readable foundation that complements the stylized 'Tomorrow' headlines.

sans-serif.$description: Fallback and utilitarian text in less prominent contexts.
